scope: 供 Equation Lab / Reaction Builder 使用的高中无机受控组合与 palette 规则。

palette.more_elements_policy: All remaining canonical element projections are available behind explicit expansion/search.

ionic_compound.algorithm: Use canonical ion integer charges; reduce absolute charge ratio by gcd to obtain the smallest neutral integer stoichiometry.
ionic_compound.parentheses: When a polyatomic ion coefficient is greater than 1, formula rendering surrounds the polyatomic group with parentheses unless its canonical notation already requires brackets.

composition.variable_valence: If an element maps to multiple plausible canonical ion/oxidation states, return matching canonical Substance/Ion candidates and require user selection. Never infer one oxidation state merely to make a neutral formula.
composition.covalent_species: Do not synthesize arbitrary covalent molecules from element token counts. Return only canonical species candidates already present in the dataset.
composition.unknown_combination: Return an explicit unsupported/no-canonical-candidate state rather than fabricate a species.

molecular.output: Substance participants with coefficients and phases

ionic.output: Strong aqueous electrolytes may be projected to ions according to electrolytes.json

net_ionic.output: Project eligible species, cancel unchanged spectator ions, validate atom and charge conservation

typography_contract.formula_digits: render as subscripts except stoichiometric coefficient
typography_contract.storage: canonical data stays ASCII/machine-readable; presentation markup is generated by UI
